{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the sales data with proper handling of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the count of loyal completed orders
loyal_completed_count = len(sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
])

# Check if there are any refunded orders for loyal customers
refunded_loyal = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded')
]

# Print counts and first few refunded loyal orders to verify
loyal_completed_count, refunded_loyal.head()"}
